+module
+
+public import TauCeti.LinearAlgebra.RootSystem.SimplyConnectedRootDatum.GeckLattice.Positive.Generated.Basic
+
+/-!
+# Free base change of the generated positive Geck subgroup
+
+The subgroup generated by the positive numbered Geck root subgroups and weight torus commutes
+with free scalar extension, in particular with every extension of fields. The comparison is an
+isomorphism of coordinate Hopf algebras. It commutes with the closed inclusions into the general
+linear group and into the full generated Geck subgroup. Thus the positive subgroup used in a
+Borel construction can be compared on geometric fibres together with its ambient group.
+
+The generators themselves commute with arbitrary scalar extension. Freeness is used only for
+commutation of their common-kernel Hopf ideal with scalar extension. No identification with the
+specialization of the integral toral closure is made.
+
+## Main declarations
+
+* `TauCeti.DynkinType.map_baseChangeHopfIdeal_geckPositiveGeneratedDefiningIdeal`:
+  free base change carries the positive generated defining ideal onto its counterpart.
+* `TauCeti.DynkinType.geckPositiveGeneratedCoordinateHopfAlgebraBaseChangeIso`:
+  the coordinate-algebra comparison.
+* `baseChangeMap_quotientMapOfLe_geckPositiveGenerated_comp_baseChangeIso_hom`:
+  compatibility with restriction from the full generated subgroup.
+
+## References
+
+* M. Geck, *On the construction of semisimple Lie algebras and Chevalley groups*,
+  Proc. Amer. Math. Soc. **145** (2017), 3233--3247.
+* B. Conrad, *Reductive Group Schemes*, §1.
+
+The construction follows the full generated subgroup comparison in
+`TauCeti.LinearAlgebra.RootSystem.SimplyConnectedRootDatum.GeckLattice.Generated.Basic`, using
+the common-kernel base-change and quotient-transport constructions in
+`TauCeti.Algebra.AlgebraicGroup.HopfIdeal.BaseChange`.
+-/
+
+public section
+
+namespace TauCeti.DynkinType
+
+open CategoryTheory
+
+universe v w
+
+noncomputable section
+
+variable (t : DynkinType) (ht : t.Valid)
+variable (k : Type v) (K : Type max v w) [CommRing k] [CommRing K] [Algebra k K]
+
+/-- **Generation of the positive Geck subgroup commutes with free base change.** The ideal
+is transported through the ambient general-linear coordinate-algebra comparison. -/
+theorem map_baseChangeHopfIdeal_geckPositiveGeneratedDefiningIdeal [Module.Free k K] :
+    (CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K)
+        (t.geckPositiveGeneratedDefiningIdeal ht k)).map
+        (GeneralLinear.coordinateHopfAlgebraBaseChangeIso k K (t.geckDim ht)).hom.hom =
+      t.geckPositiveGeneratedDefiningIdeal ht K := by
+  rw [geckPositiveGeneratedDefiningIdeal_def, geckPositiveGeneratedDefiningIdeal_def]
+  apply CommHopfAlgCat.map_baseChangeHopfIdeal_commonKernelHopfIdeal
+    (t.geckPositiveGeneratorCoordinateMap ht k)
+    (GeneralLinear.coordinateHopfAlgebraBaseChangeIso k K (t.geckDim ht))
+    (fun j ↦ match j with
+      | .inl i => t.geckGeneratorCoordinateAlgebraBaseChangeIso k K (.inl (.inl i))
+      | .inr u => t.geckGeneratorCoordinateAlgebraBaseChangeIso k K (.inr u))
+    (t.geckPositiveGeneratorCoordinateMap ht K)
+  rintro (i | u)
+  · simpa only [geckPositiveGeneratorCoordinateMap_inl, Category.assoc] using
+      t.geckGeneratorCoordinateMap_baseChange ht k K (.inl (.inl i))
+  · cases u
+    simpa only [geckPositiveGeneratorCoordinateMap_inr, Category.assoc] using
+      t.geckGeneratorCoordinateMap_baseChange ht k K (.inr ())
+
+/-- The scalar extension of the positive generated coordinate algebra is the coordinate algebra
+of the positive subgroup generated over the extension ring. -/
+def geckPositiveGeneratedCoordinateHopfAlgebraBaseChangeIso [Module.Free k K] :
+    CommHopfAlgCat.baseChange (K := K) (t.geckPositiveGeneratedCoordinateHopfAlgebra ht k) ≅
+      t.geckPositiveGeneratedCoordinateHopfAlgebra ht K :=
+  CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeIsoOfEqQuotient
+    (t.geckPositiveGeneratedDefiningIdeal ht k) (t.geckPositiveGeneratedDefiningIdeal ht K)
+    (t.geckPositiveGeneratedCoordinateHopfAlgebra_def ht k)
+    (t.geckPositiveGeneratedCoordinateHopfAlgebra_def ht K)
+    (GeneralLinear.coordinateHopfAlgebraBaseChangeIso k K (t.geckDim ht))
+    (t.map_baseChangeHopfIdeal_geckPositiveGeneratedDefiningIdeal ht k K)
+
+/-- The positive-subgroup comparison commutes with the ambient general-linear quotient maps. -/
+@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
+theorem baseChangeMap_geckPositiveGeneratedCoordinateMap_comp_baseChangeIso_hom [Module.Free k K] :
+    CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeMap (K := K) (t.geckPositiveGeneratedCoordinateMap ht k) ≫
+        (t.geckPositiveGeneratedCoordinateHopfAlgebraBaseChangeIso ht k K).hom =
+      (GeneralLinear.coordinateHopfAlgebraBaseChangeIso k K (t.geckDim ht)).hom ≫
+        t.geckPositiveGeneratedCoordinateMap ht K := by
+  apply CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeMap_comp_baseChangeIsoOfEqQuotient_hom
+  · rw [geckPositiveGeneratedCoordinateMap_def]
+    simp
+  · rw [geckPositiveGeneratedCoordinateMap_def]
+    simp
+
+/-- Base change of the positive subgroup inside the full generated subgroup agrees with the
+positive subgroup inside the base-changed full generated subgroup. -/
+@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
+theorem baseChangeMap_quotientMapOfLe_geckPositiveGenerated_comp_baseChangeIso_hom
+    [Module.Free k K] :
+    CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeMap (K := K) (eqToHom (t.geckGeneratedCoordinateHopfAlgebra_def ht k) ≫
+        CommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe (GeneralLinear.coordinateHopfAlgebra k (t.geckDim ht))
+          (t.geckGeneratedDefiningIdeal_le_geckPositiveGeneratedDefiningIdeal ht k) ≫
+        eqToHom (t.geckPositiveGeneratedCoordinateHopfAlgebra_def ht k).symm) ≫
+        (t.geckPositiveGeneratedCoordinateHopfAlgebraBaseChangeIso ht k K).hom =
+      (t.geckGeneratedCoordinateHopfAlgebraBaseChangeIso ht k K).hom ≫
+        eqToHom (t.geckGeneratedCoordinateHopfAlgebra_def ht K) ≫
+        CommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe (GeneralLinear.coordinateHopfAlgebra K (t.geckDim ht))
+          (t.geckGeneratedDefiningIdeal_le_geckPositiveGeneratedDefiningIdeal ht K) ≫
+        eqToHom (t.geckPositiveGeneratedCoordinateHopfAlgebra_def ht K).symm := by
+  have hsurj := CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeMap_surjective (K := K)
+    (t.geckGeneratedCoordinateMap ht k) (t.geckGeneratedCoordinateMap_surjective ht k)
+  let _ : Epi (CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeMap (K := K) (t.geckGeneratedCoordinateMap ht k)) :=
+    ConcreteCategory.epi_of_surjective _ hsurj
+  apply (cancel_epi
+    (CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeMap (K := K) (t.geckGeneratedCoordinateMap ht k))).mp
+  conv_lhs =>
+    rw [← Category.assoc, ← (CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeFunctor (K := K)).map_comp,
+      geckGeneratedCoordinateMap_def]
+    simp only [Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans_assoc, eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp,
+      CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_quotientMapOfLe_assoc]

+/-!
+# The constant one in `L∞`
+
+This file defines the constant-one element of `L∞` on an arbitrary measure space. Unlike
+`MeasureTheory.Lp.const`, the construction needs no finite-measure hypothesis because the
+essential supremum of a constant is always finite.
+-/
+
+public section
+
+noncomputable section
+
+open MeasureTheory
+open scoped ENNReal
+
+namespace TauCeti
+
+variable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
+
+/-- The constant-one element of `L∞(μ)`. -/
+noncomputable def linftyOne : Lp ℝ ∞ μ :=
+  (memLp_top_const (1 : ℝ)).toLp fun _ => 1
+
+/-- The representative of `linftyOne` is almost everywhere the constant function one. -/
+theorem coeFn_linftyOne :
+    (linftyOne (Ω := Ω) (μ := μ) : Ω → ℝ) =ᵐ[μ] fun _ => 1 :=
+  MemLp.coeFn_toLp (memLp_top_const (1 : ℝ))
+
+end TauCeti

+    simp
+  have hlt (u : ℝ≥0∞) : t < u + c ↔ t - c < u := (ENNReal.sub_lt_iff_lt_right hc hct).symm
+  simp only [hlt, ← lt_schwarzRearrangement_iff]
+
+/-- The difference of two superlevel sets of Schwarz rearrangements has measure equal to the
+truncated difference of the two original level measures, since the two sets are concentric. No
+measurability or finiteness hypothesis is needed. -/
+@[simp]
+theorem addHaar_sdiff_setOf_lt_schwarzRearrangement (f g : E → ℝ≥0∞) (s t : ℝ≥0∞) :
+    μ ({x | s < schwarzRearrangement μ f x} \ {x | t < schwarzRearrangement μ g x}) =
+      μ {x | s < f x} - μ {x | t < g x} := by
+  rcases le_total (μ {x | s < f x}) (μ {x | t < g x}) with h | h
+  · rw [sdiff_eq_empty.2 (setOf_lt_schwarzRearrangement_subset μ h), measure_empty,
+      tsub_eq_zero_of_le h]
+  rcases eq_or_ne (μ {x | t < g x}) ∞ with hg | hg
+  · -- Both level measures are infinite, so the two rearranged superlevel sets coincide.
+    have hf : μ {x | s < f x} = ∞ := top_le_iff.1 (hg ▸ h)
+    rw [setOf_lt_schwarzRearrangement, setOf_lt_schwarzRearrangement, hf, hg, sdiff_self,
+      measure_empty, tsub_self]
+  rw [measure_sdiff (setOf_lt_schwarzRearrangement_subset μ h)
+      (measurableSet_lt measurable_const (measurable_schwarzRearrangement μ g)).nullMeasurableSet
+      (by rwa [addHaar_setOf_lt_schwarzRearrangement]),
+    addHaar_setOf_lt_schwarzRearrangement, addHaar_setOf_lt_schwarzRearrangement]
+
+/-- One-sided `L¹` contraction: the integral of the truncated difference `f - g` can only decrease
+under Schwarz rearrangement. -/
+private theorem lintegral_sub_schwarzRearrangement_le {f g : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ)
+    (hg : AEMeasurable g μ) :
+    ∫⁻ x, (schwarzRearrangement μ f x - schwarzRearrangement μ g x) ∂μ ≤
+      ∫⁻ x, (f x - g x) ∂μ := by
+  rw [lintegral_sub_eq_lintegral_measure_sdiff μ
+      (measurable_schwarzRearrangement μ f).aemeasurable
+      (measurable_schwarzRearrangement μ g).aemeasurable,
+    lintegral_sub_eq_lintegral_measure_sdiff μ hf hg]
+  refine lintegral_mono fun s ↦ ?_
+  rw [addHaar_sdiff_setOf_lt_schwarzRearrangement]
+  exact le_measure_sdiff
+
+/-- One-sided `L¹` contraction for the hinge `(f - g - c)⁺`, by rearranging `g + c`. -/
+private theorem lintegral_sub_sub_schwarzRearrangement_le {f g : E → ℝ≥0∞}
+    (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) (hg : AEMeasurable g μ) (c : ℝ≥0∞) :
+    ∫⁻ x, (schwarzRearrangement μ f x - schwarzRearrangement μ g x - c) ∂μ ≤
+      ∫⁻ x, (f x - g x - c) ∂μ := by
+  simp_rw [tsub_tsub]
+  have h := lintegral_sub_schwarzRearrangement_le μ hf (hg.add_const c)
+  rwa [schwarzRearrangement_add_const] at h
+
+/-- **One-sided `Lᵖ` contraction of Schwarz rearrangement.** For `1 ≤ p`, the integral of the
+`p`-th power of the truncated difference `f - g` can only decrease under Schwarz rearrangement. -/
+theorem lintegral_sub_rpow_schwarzRearrangement_le {f g : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ)
+    (hg : AEMeasurable g μ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
+    ∫⁻ x, (schwarzRearrangement μ f x - schwarzRearrangement μ g x) ^ p ∂μ ≤
+      ∫⁻ x, (f x - g x) ^ p ∂μ := by
+  rcases hp.eq_or_lt with rfl | hp
+  · simpa only [ENNReal.rpow_one] using lintegral_sub_schwarzRearrangement_le μ hf hg
+  -- Pass to measurable representatives, so that the hinge integrals can be swapped.
+  have hfg : ∫⁻ x, (f x - g x) ^ p ∂μ = ∫⁻ x, (hf.mk f x - hg.mk g x) ^ p ∂μ :=
+    lintegral_congr_ae <| by
+      filter_upwards [hf.ae_eq_mk, hg.ae_eq_mk] with x hfx hgx
+      rw [hfx, hgx]
+  rw [schwarzRearrangement_congr_ae μ hf.ae_eq_mk, schwarzRearrangement_congr_ae μ hg.ae_eq_mk,
+    hfg]
+  set F := hf.mk f
+  set G := hg.mk g
+  have hF : Measurable F := hf.measurable_mk
+  have hG : Measurable G := hg.measurable_mk
+  have hF' := measurable_schwarzRearrangement μ F
+  have hG' := measurable_schwarzRearrangement μ G
+  -- Write the power as a mixture of the hinges `f - g - r`, each of which contracts.
+  simp_rw [rpow_eq_lintegral_mul_sub hp]
+  rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap (by fun_prop)]
+  conv_rhs => rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap (by fun_prop)]
+  refine lintegral_mono fun r ↦ ?_
+  rw [lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top,
+    lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top]
+  exact mul_le_mul_right
+    (lintegral_sub_sub_schwarzRearrangement_le μ hF.aemeasurable hG.aemeasurable _) _
+
+/-- **`Lᵖ` contraction of Schwarz rearrangement**, integral form. For `1 ≤ p`, the integral of
+the `p`-th power of the extended distance between two nonnegative functions can only decrease
+under Schwarz rearrangement. -/
+theorem lintegral_edist_rpow_schwarzRearrangement_le {f g : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ)
+    (hg : AEMeasurable g μ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
+    ∫⁻ x, edist (schwarzRearrangement μ f x) (schwarzRearrangement μ g x) ^ p ∂μ ≤
+      ∫⁻ x, edist (f x) (g x) ^ p ∂μ := by
+  -- Of the two truncated differences `a - b` and `b - a`, one vanishes and the other is the
+  -- extended distance.
+  have hsplit (a b : ℝ≥0∞) : edist a b ^ p = (a - b) ^ p + (b - a) ^ p := by
+    have hp0 : 0 < p := zero_lt_one.trans_le hp
+    rw [ENNReal.edist_eq_max]
+    rcases le_total a b with h | h
+    · rw [tsub_eq_zero_of_le h, max_eq_right zero_le, ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos hp0, zero_add]
+    · rw [tsub_eq_zero_of_le h, max_eq_left zero_le, ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos hp0, add_zero]
+  simp_rw [hsplit]
+  rw [lintegral_add_left (by fun_prop), lintegral_add_left' (by fun_prop)]
+  exact add_le_add (lintegral_sub_rpow_schwarzRearrangement_le μ hf hg hp)
+    (lintegral_sub_rpow_schwarzRearrangement_le μ hg hf hp)
+
+/-- **`L^∞` contraction of Schwarz rearrangement.** The extended distance between two Schwarz
+rearrangements is bounded everywhere by the essential supremum of the distance between the two
+functions. No measurability hypothesis is needed. -/
+theorem edist_schwarzRearrangement_le_essSup (f g : E → ℝ≥0∞) (x : E) :
+    edist (schwarzRearrangement μ f x) (schwarzRearrangement μ g x) ≤
+      essSup (fun y ↦ edist (f y) (g y)) μ := by
+  set c := essSup (fun y ↦ edist (f y) (g y)) μ
+  have h := ENNReal.ae_le_essSup (μ := μ) fun y ↦ edist (f y) (g y)
+  have hfg : schwarzRearrangement μ f ≤ fun x ↦ schwarzRearrangement μ g x + c := by
+    rw [← schwarzRearrangement_add_const]
+    exact schwarzRearrangement_mono_ae μ
+      (h.mono fun y hy ↦ ((ENNReal.edist_le_iff_le_add_right _ _ _).1 hy).1)
+  have hgf : schwarzRearrangement μ g ≤ fun x ↦ schwarzRearrangement μ f x + c := by
+    rw [← schwarzRearrangement_add_const]
+    exact schwarzRearrangement_mono_ae μ
+      (h.mono fun y hy ↦ ((ENNReal.edist_le_iff_le_add_right _ _ _).1 hy).2)
+  exact (ENNReal.edist_le_iff_le_add_right _ _ _).2 ⟨hfg x, hgf x⟩
+
+/-- **`Lᵖ` contraction of Schwarz rearrangement.** For every exponent `1 ≤ p ≤ ∞`, the `Lᵖ`
+seminorm of the extended distance between two nonnegative functions can only decrease under
+Schwarz rearrangement. -/
+theorem eLpNorm_edist_schwarzRearrangement_le {f g : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ)
+    (hg : AEMeasurable g μ) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
+    eLpNorm (fun x ↦ edist (schwarzRearrangement μ f x) (schwarzRearrangement μ g x)) p μ ≤
+      eLpNorm (fun x ↦ edist (f x) (g x)) p μ := by
+  -- The extended distance on `ℝ≥0∞` is the maximum of the two truncated differences.
+  have hmeas {u v : E → ℝ≥0∞} (hu : AEMeasurable u μ) (hv : AEMeasurable v μ) :
+      AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ edist (u x) (v x)) μ := by
+    simp_rw [ENNReal.edist_eq_max]
+    exact ((hu.sub hv).max (hv.sub hu)).aestronglyMeasurable
+  have hf' := (measurable_schwarzRearrangement μ f).aemeasurable (μ := μ)
+  have hg' := (measurable_schwarzRearrangement μ g).aemeasurable (μ := μ)
+  rcases eq_or_ne p ∞ with rfl | hptop
+  · rw [eLpNorm_exponent_top (hmeas hf' hg'), eLpNorm_exponent_top (hmeas hf hg),
+      eLpNormEssSup_eq_essSup_enorm, eLpNormEssSup_eq_essSup_enorm]
+    simp only [enorm_eq_self]
+    exact essSup_le_of_ae_le _
+      (.of_forall (edist_schwarzRearrangement_le_essSup μ f g))
+  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := (zero_lt_one.trans_le hp).ne'
+  rw [eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal hp0 hptop (hmeas hf' hg'),
+    eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal hp0 hptop (hmeas hf hg)]
+  simp only [enorm_eq_self]
+  exact ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow (lintegral_edist_rpow_schwarzRearrangement_le μ hf hg
+    (by simpa using ENNReal.toReal_mono hptop hp)) (by positivity)
+

+module
+
+public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Haar.Unique
+public import Mathlib.NumberTheory.LocalField.Basic
+import TauCeti.LinearAlgebra.FreeModule.CardQuotient
+
+/-!
+# Scaling of Haar measure on `ι → K` under integral matrices
+
+Let `K` be a nonarchimedean local field with residue field of cardinality `q`, and let `A` be a
+square matrix over `𝒪[K]` whose determinant is associated to `ϖ ^ k` for a uniformizer `ϖ`.
+Acting on `ι → K` by `mulVec`, `A` multiplies Haar measure by `q ^ (-k)`. This is the
+nonarchimedean analogue of Mathlib's `MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_image_linearMap`, where the
+factor is `|det|` for a real vector space.
+
+The proof runs through the lattice index. The image under `A` of the integer box
+`∏ i, 𝒪[K]` is a subgroup of index `q ^ k` in it
+(`Matrix.card_quotient_range_mulVecLin_eq_pow`), so the box is the disjoint union of `q ^ k`
+translates of that image, and Mathlib's `MeasureTheory.AddSubgroup.index_mul_measure` turns this
+into the measure identity. On a translate of a scaled box — that is, on a ball of `ι → K` — the
+same identity holds for every left-invariant measure, with no regularity hypothesis. For a general
+set the measure `s ↦ μ (A '' s)` is again a Haar measure, so by uniqueness of Haar measure it is a
+constant multiple of `μ`, and the box computes the constant; this needs `μ` to be regular.
+
+These volumes are the change of variables in Serre's proof of his mass formula for totally
+ramified extensions, where `A` is the matrix of multiplication by an element of the ring of
+integers of an extension of `K` in an integral basis and `k` is the valuation of its norm.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `MeasureTheory.Measure.measure_image_mulVec_univ_pi_integer`: for a left-invariant `μ`,
+  the image of the integer box has measure `q ^ (-k)` times that of the box.
+* `MeasureTheory.Measure.measure_image_mulVec_vadd_smul_univ_pi_integer`: the same for every
+  ball `x +ᵥ c • ∏ i, 𝒪[K]` with `c ≠ 0`.
+* `MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_image_mulVec`: for a regular Haar measure `μ`,
+  `μ (A '' s) = q ^ (-k) * μ s` for every set `s`.
+
+## References
+
+* J.-P. Serre, *Une « formule de masse » pour les extensions totalement ramifiées de degré donné
+  d'un corps local*, C. R. Acad. Sci. Paris Sér. A **286** (1978), 1031–1036, §3.
+-/
+
+public section
+
+open Set ValuativeRel
+open scoped ENNReal Pointwise
+
+namespace MeasureTheory.Measure
+
+variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [ValuativeRel K] [TopologicalSpace K]
+  [IsNonarchimedeanLocalField K] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
+  [MeasurableSpace (ι → K)] [BorelSpace (ι → K)]
+
+/-- **The scaling law on the integer box.** If the determinant of a square matrix `A` over
+`𝒪[K]` is associated to `ϖ ^ k` for a uniformizer `ϖ`, then for every left-invariant measure on
+`ι → K`, the image of the integer box `∏ i, 𝒪[K]` under `A` has `q ^ (-k)` times the measure of
+the box, where `q = Nat.card 𝓀[K]`. -/
+theorem measure_image_mulVec_univ_pi_integer (μ : Measure (ι → K)) [μ.IsAddLeftInvariant]
+    {A : Matrix ι ι 𝒪[K]} {ϖ : 𝒪[K]} (hϖ : Irreducible ϖ) {k : ℕ}
+    (hk : Associated A.det (ϖ ^ k)) :
+    μ ((A.map (algebraMap 𝒪[K] K)).mulVec '' univ.pi fun _ ↦ (𝒪[K] : Set K)) =
+      1 / (Nat.card 𝓀[K] : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k * μ (univ.pi fun _ ↦ (𝒪[K] : Set K)) := by
+  -- Pull `μ` back to the compact group `ι → 𝒪[K]`, whose image in `ι → K` is the box.
+  let _ : MeasurableSpace (ι → 𝒪[K]) := borel _
+  have _ : BorelSpace (ι → 𝒪[K]) := ⟨rfl⟩
+  let j : (ι → 𝒪[K]) →+ (ι → K) := (algebraMap 𝒪[K] K).toAddMonoidHom.compLeft ι
+  have hj_apply (a : ι → 𝒪[K]) : j a = algebraMap 𝒪[K] K ∘ a := rfl
+  have hj : MeasurableEmbedding j := by
+    refine (Continuous.isClosedEmbedding ?_ fun a b hab ↦ ?_).measurableEmbedding
+    · refine continuous_pi fun i ↦ ?_
+      simp only [hj_apply, Function.comp_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_ofSubsemiring_apply]
+      fun_prop
+    · funext i
+      simpa [hj_apply] using congrFun hab i
+  have hrange : range j = univ.pi fun _ ↦ (𝒪[K] : Set K) := by
+    ext x
+    simp only [mem_range, mem_univ_pi, SetLike.mem_coe]
+    refine ⟨?_, fun h ↦ ⟨fun i ↦ ⟨x i, h i⟩, ?_⟩⟩
+    · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩ i
+      simp [hj_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_ofSubsemiring_apply]
+    · funext i
+      simp [hj_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_ofSubsemiring_apply]
+  -- The image of `A` is a subgroup of `ι → 𝒪[K]` of index `q ^ k`.
+  let H := (LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin).toAddSubgroup
+  have hindex : H.index = Nat.card 𝓀[K] ^ k := by
+    rw [AddSubgroup.index_eq_card]
+    -- The quotient by a submodule is by definition the quotient by its additive subgroup.
+    exact Matrix.card_quotient_range_mulVecLin_eq_pow hϖ hk
+  have _ : H.FiniteIndex := ⟨by rw [hindex]; exact pow_ne_zero _ Nat.card_pos.ne'⟩
+  have hH : MeasurableSet (H : Set (ι → 𝒪[K])) :=
+    (isCompact_range (by fun_prop : Continuous A.mulVecLin)).isClosed.measurableSet
+  have himage : j '' H = (A.map (algebraMap 𝒪[K] K)).mulVec '' range j := by
+    simp only [H, Submodule.coe_toAddSubgroup, LinearMap.coe_range, ← range_comp]
+    congr 1
+    funext a i
+    simp [hj_apply, RingHom.map_mulVec]
+  have _ := IsAddLeftInvariant.comap μ hj
+  have h := MeasureTheory.AddSubgroup.index_mul_measure H hH (μ.comap j)
+  rw [hj.comap_apply, hj.comap_apply, image_univ, hindex, himage, hrange] at h
+  have hq : (Nat.card 𝓀[K] : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by simp [Nat.card_pos.ne'])
+  rw [← h, Nat.cast_pow, ← mul_assoc, one_div, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hq (by simp), one_mul]
+
+/-- **The scaling law on balls.** If the determinant of a square matrix `A` over `𝒪[K]` is
+associated to `ϖ ^ k` for a uniformizer `ϖ`, then for every left-invariant measure on `ι → K`,
+the image under `A` of the ball `x +ᵥ c • ∏ i, 𝒪[K]` (with `c ≠ 0`) has `q ^ (-k)` times the
+measure of the ball, where `q = Nat.card 𝓀[K]`. -/
+theorem measure_image_mulVec_vadd_smul_univ_pi_integer (μ : Measure (ι → K))
+    [μ.IsAddLeftInvariant] {A : Matrix ι ι 𝒪[K]} {ϖ : 𝒪[K]} (hϖ : Irreducible ϖ) {k : ℕ}
+    (hk : Associated A.det (ϖ ^ k)) (x : ι → K) {c : K} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
+    μ ((A.map (algebraMap 𝒪[K] K)).mulVec '' (x +ᵥ c • univ.pi fun _ ↦ (𝒪[K] : Set K))) =
+      (1 : ℝ≥0∞) / (Nat.card 𝓀[K] : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k *
+        μ (x +ᵥ c • univ.pi fun _ ↦ (𝒪[K] : Set K)) := by
+  -- The measure `T ↦ μ (c • T)` is again left invariant, so the box form applies to it.
+  let e : (ι → K) ≃ᵐ (ι → K) := MeasurableEquiv.smul₀ c⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero hc)
+  have he (T : Set (ι → K)) : μ.map e T = μ (c • T) := by
+    rw [e.map_apply, MeasurableEquiv.coe_smul₀, preimage_smul_inv₀ hc]
+  -- `e` is scalar multiplication by `c⁻¹`, an additive endomorphism.
+  have _ : (μ.map e).IsAddLeftInvariant :=
+    isAddLeftInvariant_map (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom (ι → K) c⁻¹).toAddHom e.measurable
+      e.surjective
+  have h := measure_image_mulVec_univ_pi_integer (μ.map e) hϖ hk
+  rw [he, he] at h
+  rw [← Matrix.coe_mulVecLin, image_vadd_distrib, image_smul_set, measure_vadd, measure_vadd,
+    Matrix.coe_mulVecLin, h]
+
+/-- **The scaling law for Haar measure.** If the determinant of a square matrix `A` over `𝒪[K]`
+is associated to `ϖ ^ k` for a uniformizer `ϖ`, then for every regular additive Haar measure `μ`
+on `ι → K` and every set `s`, `μ (A '' s) = q ^ (-k) * μ s`, where `q = Nat.card 𝓀[K]`. This is
+the nonarchimedean analogue of `MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_image_linearMap`. -/
+theorem addHaar_image_mulVec (μ : Measure (ι → K)) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
+    {A : Matrix ι ι 𝒪[K]} {ϖ : 𝒪[K]} (hϖ : Irreducible ϖ) {k : ℕ}
+    (hk : Associated A.det (ϖ ^ k)) (s : Set (ι → K)) :
+    μ ((A.map (algebraMap 𝒪[K] K)).mulVec '' s) = 1 / (Nat.card 𝓀[K] : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k * μ s := by
+  have hdet : IsUnit (A.map (algebraMap 𝒪[K] K)).det := by
+    rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero, ← RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, ← RingHom.map_det, ne_eq,
+      FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_eq_zero_iff]
+    exact hk.ne_zero_iff.mpr (pow_ne_zero k hϖ.ne_zero)
+  set A' := A.map (algebraMap 𝒪[K] K)
+  -- The measure `T ↦ μ (A' '' T)` is the image of `μ` under the inverse of `A'`.
+  let f : (ι → K) ≃ₜ (ι → K) :=
+    { toFun := A'⁻¹.mulVec
+      invFun := A'.mulVec
+      left_inv v := by simp [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hdet]
+      right_inv v := by simp [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hdet]
+      continuous_toFun := continuous_const.matrix_mulVec continuous_id
+      continuous_invFun := continuous_const.matrix_mulVec continuous_id }
+  have hf (T : Set (ι → K)) : μ.map f T = μ (A'.mulVec '' T) := by
+    rw [← f.toMeasurableEquiv_coe, MeasurableEquiv.map_apply, f.toMeasurableEquiv_coe,
+      ← f.image_symm]
+    -- `f.symm` is `A'.mulVec` by construction.
+    rfl
+  -- `f` is the linear map `A'⁻¹.mulVecLin`.
+  have _ : (μ.map f).IsAddLeftInvariant :=
+    isAddLeftInvariant_map A'⁻¹.mulVecLin.toAddMonoidHom.toAddHom f.continuous.measurable
+      f.surjective
+  have _ : (μ.map f).Regular := Regular.map f
+  have hsmul := isAddLeftInvariant_eq_smul_of_regular (μ.map f) μ
+  -- The constant is read off the integer box, which is compact and open.
+  have hB0 : μ (univ.pi fun _ ↦ (𝒪[K] : Set K)) ≠ 0 :=
+    (isOpen_set_pi finite_univ fun _ _ ↦ Valuation.isOpen_integer).measure_ne_zero μ
+      ⟨0, fun _ _ ↦ zero_mem _⟩
+  have hBtop : μ (univ.pi fun _ ↦ (𝒪[K] : Set K)) ≠ ∞ :=
+    (isCompact_univ_pi fun _ ↦
+      isCompact_iff_compactSpace.2 (inferInstanceAs (CompactSpace 𝒪[K]))).measure_lt_top.ne
+  have hc : (addHaarScalarFactor (μ.map f) μ : ℝ≥0∞) = 1 / (Nat.card 𝓀[K] : ℝ≥0∞) ^ k := by
+    have h := measure_image_mulVec_univ_pi_integer μ hϖ hk
+    rw [← hf, hsmul, Measure.smul_apply, ENNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul] at h
+    exact (ENNReal.mul_left_inj hB0 hBtop).1 h
+  rw [← hf, hsmul, Measure.smul_apply, ENNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul, hc]
+
+end MeasureTheory.Measure
